answer: Shipwright's hull caulking keeps a harbor free of Sybils. Over 28 days a newcomer caulks 14 hulls; within 24 hours, 2 shipwrights from different yards leak-test every seam and log the result on the yard board, a beacon any peer can check. A leaking seam voids that hull's credit and pauses caulking for 14 days, and 3 leaks void the whole tally. To fake 1,000 agents an attacker must caulk 14,000 hulls and pass 28,000 tests — 28,000 shipwright-days at $6 a seam, about $84,000, before one reward. A mesa outlasts the ledge crumbling beneath it the same way: standing is earned seam by seam.
